data.one_liner: Simple 360-degree video player plugin for Android and iOS
data.what_it_does: Provides a Video360View widget to render and control 360-degree videos using native ExoPlayer on Android and Swifty360Player on iOS. Allows playing, stopping, resetting, jumping to specific positions, and seeking.
use_when: You need to play 360-degree videos within a Flutter application on Android or iOS.
You need standard playback controls like play, stop, reset, and seeking for 360 videos.
avoid_when: You are targeting platforms other than Android and iOS (such as Web or Desktop).
You only need a standard video player without 360-degree capabilities.
strengths: Supports native hardware via ExoPlayer (Android) and Swifty360Player (iOS).
Provides a straightforward API and controller methods for managing video playback.
weaknesses: Limited platform support (only Android and iOS are documented).
No web or desktop support listed.
data.setup_notes: Requires Flutter >=3.24.0 and Dart >=3.5.0. Android minimum SDK target is 19. iOS minimum target is 12.0 with Swift 5.x.

alternatives.name: video_player
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need a standard video player for multiple platforms without 360-degree functionality.
